race.comment: LA PROFECIA (5) hasn't been too far off them in town of late and should find this assignment a touch easier than recent outings. Cherry-ripe fit for this and maps ideally from gate three. Sure to play a major role in the outcome. PUROSANGUE (1) has a win and a second from two attempts over this trip, gets 3kg off with the claim and draws the inside alley. Plenty to like about his prospects. HOMERIC (7) was a touch plain at the latest effort but the two runs prior were full of merit. Watch for a spike in form. CHAMPAGNE PROBLEMS (11) strips fitter second-up from the break and may earn some minor money.
